text.text: Build a rectangular floor of valid smeltery floor blocks, with walls around an empty interior. Glass cannot be used as the floor.
For a small start, surround a one-block interior with four wall blocks, place a valid floor block beneath it, and leave the top open.
Place the controller and a seared tank in the walls. Fill the tank with a supported fluid fuel before melting. The interior may be enlarged to hold more material.
This version has limits on valid structures. A static Small Smeltery Plan is shown when its block choices match the current tags. The original book’s animated structure display is not available here.
